# Critical flows

## Source CSV to codebook

1. The CLI calls load_rows(), validates required columns and pattern IDs, and hashes source bytes. ([`scripts/generate_codebook.py:225`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L225), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:44`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L44))
2. render() builds the manual; --check compares exact output and exits with an error on drift, while ordinary invocation writes CODEBOOK.md. ([`scripts/generate_codebook.py:226`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L226), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:228`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L228), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:236`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L236))

## Frozen source to reproducible extraction

1. The normalise CLI requires configuration/output paths. build() loads configuration against its schema and checks the configured source checksum, headers, values, namespace, and ID uniqueness. ([`lit_pattern/normalise.py:187`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L187), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:64`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L64), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:23`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L23), [`lit_pattern/common.py:63`](../../../lit_pattern/common.py#L63))
2. Source rows produce patterns, units, invented examples, shared rules, and preserved candidate cells. Only configured relation decisions produce typed relations; unresolved semantics are reported rather than inferred. ([`lit_pattern/normalise.py:75`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L75), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:107`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L107), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:134`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L134))
3. The output mapping includes original source bytes, hashes, and counts. persist() rejects unsafe/unowned destinations and unexpected files; writes replace generated files, while --check compares all expected bytes without writing. ([`lit_pattern/normalise.py:133`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L133), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:135`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L135), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:146`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L146))

## Private annotation bundle to conformance report

1. The validator rebuilds expected extraction in memory and requires an exact matching catalogue before reading the input bundle; stale data is rejected. ([`lit_pattern/validate.py:233`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L233), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:234`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L234), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:240`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L240))
2. The local schema rejects malformed structure and unknown fields. Python checks source/schema/pattern versions and work, unit, reviewer, evidence, and adjudication references. ([`lit_pattern/validate.py:56`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L56), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:68`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L68), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:81`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L81))
3. Absence requires scope/adequacy inspection evidence. Present STR05/06/07/09/10 annotations receive configured evidence checks; event references/order and knowledge maps are checked. Uncertain/absent decisions do not have to invent a positive chain. ([`lit_pattern/validate.py:132`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L132), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:152`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L152), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:139`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L139), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:166`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L166))
4. The CLI emits versions, source checksum, actual supplied counts, errors with paths/codes, and a scope warning. Exit 0 means conformance; it does not verify the truth of the evidence or run a pilot. ([`lit_pattern/validate.py:248`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L248), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:256`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L256), [`docs/30_design/304_annotation_file_contract.md:173`](../../30_design/304_annotation_file_contract.md#L173))
